captions.detailed: A Victorian-style garrison cannon featuring a heavy, dark cast-iron barrel mounted on a brown wooden two-wheel platform carriage. Two large, solid dark-grey wheels are attached via revolute joints on the sides of the carriage, allowing the entire structure to roll. The barrel is mounted on revolute trunnion joints for elevation adjustment, and a small hand-wheel is located on the right cheek of the carriage for lateral aiming controls.
captions.instruction: Generate a Victorian coastal garrison cannon with a heavy cast-iron barrel on elevation trunnion joints, supported by a wooden two-wheel carriage. The assembly should include revolute joints for the side wheels and a small lateral hand-wheel on the right side of the carriage.
captions.factory: Construct the main carriage base and side cheeks using box primitives, styled with a brown wood material. Model the cannon barrel using nested cylinders of decreasing radii, adding small cylinders for the trunnions and a hollowed cylinder for the muzzle. Create the two side wheels and axles using cylinders, and add a small hand-wheel assembly consisting of a thin cylinder and spokes. Assemble all components using revolute joints for the barrel elevation, wheel rotation, and hand-wheel rotation.
